notes: Bounded audit of s03 sysfs/kernfs ->store() and analogous attribute-store paths. kernfs core (fs/kernfs/file.c:293-319) always allocates len+1 and sets buf[len]='\0' before ops->write, so all DEVICE_ATTR/DRIVER_ATTR/BUS_ATTR/CLASS_ATTR/module_param stores receive NUL-terminated, PAGE_SIZE-bounded buf; no exception found in-snapshot. Cross-checked every copy_from_user/memdup_user write handler reachable from attribute-like stores. Strongest candidate: proc_scsi_host_write (drivers/scsi/scsi_proc.c:64-87) copies user data into a full PAGE and passes (page,count) unmodified to shost->hostt->write_info callbacks; wd33c93_write_info (drivers/scsi/wd33c93.c:1996-2059) writes buf[len]='\0' at the exact last byte of the page -> off-by-one out-of-bounds write when count==PAGE_SIZE (PROC_BLOCK_SIZE=PAGE_SIZE), plus unterminated strncmp/simple_strtoul scanning when count==PAGE_SIZE-1... buf[len] at last byte is in-bounds for len<=PAGE_SIZE-1; for len==PAGE_SIZE it writes 1 byte past the page. scsi_debug_write_info and proc_scsi_devinfo_write handle termination safely.
candidates: wd33c93_write_info: off-by-one OOB write at buf[len] when len==PAGE_SIZE; reported
proc_scsi_devinfo_write: length<PAGE_SIZE adds NUL, length==PAGE_SIZE requires buffer[PAGE_SIZE-1] NUL else -EINVAL; safe
scsi_debug_write_info: memcpy minLen<=15 into arr[16], arr[minLen]='\0'; safe
bpmp_debug_store: memdup_user then raw byte payload to firmware, no string parse; safe
nsim_dev_trap_fa_cookie_write: memdup_user then hex2bin of (count-1)/2 bytes; no string parse; safe
